canonical_name: Wester Hermiston AI Data Centre Campus

aliases.alias: Land 300 Metres North Of 50 Research Avenue North, Riccarton

summary: Proposed 200 MW 'AI data centre campus' by Apatura (SPV Apatura DC Project 11 Ltd) on Green Belt farmland at Wester Hermiston, north of Heriot-Watt University's Riccarton campus and west of the Edinburgh City Bypass, near Currie. A Proposal of Application Notice (25/03978/PAN) was submitted on 1 August 2025 for a forthcoming full ('national development') planning application. City of Edinburgh Council concluded twice that EIA was not required (25/02924/SCR on 7 July 2025 and 25/05576/SCR on 6 May 2026), but a third-party screening-direction request was received by Scottish Government Planning and Architecture on 18 May 2026. Scottish Ministers issued their direction on 17 August 2026: an EIA is required. Design documents describe three data centre buildings totalling c.54,690 m2 footprint connected to Currie Substation, with £1.4bn claimed investment. A local campaign, APRS and the Cockburn Association oppose or question the scheme, in the wake of the refusal of the nearby South Gyle data centre in February 2026.
maturity_explanation: PAN submitted 1 August 2025 and reported to the Development Management Sub-Committee on 25 March 2026 as a 'forthcoming application'. Two council EIA screenings concluded EIA was not required, but Scottish Ministers' later direction EIA-230-002, issued 17 August 2026, requires an Environmental Impact Assessment. Early development remains M1, not M2: no validated full planning application for the data centre itself has been verified.

latest_development.headline: Scottish Ministers direct that an Environmental Impact Assessment is required for the Wester Hermiston proposal (DPEA EIA-230-002), superseding the practical effect of the council's earlier no-EIA opinions
